top_signals.title: Lula’s Lead Over Bolsonaro Shrinks as Brazil Campaign Opens
top_signals.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed to 1 point as official campaigning began, with the conservative challenger stepping up criticism of Brazil’s mounting debt problems in a bid to close the gap.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
